required_behavior: Authenticate and authorize before replay disclosure; workspace pending-count and nonempty oldest-pending-reservation-age refusals (both 429) precede deployment overload (503) when predicates coincide.

Development 32/8/2m and standard 256/32/10m are finite deployment/workspace pending-count/age profiles; generated local development selects development; 3/2/30s is test-only and 1000/1h is not a production default.

Reserve pending capacity atomically with idempotency, RunSpec/grant/run, separate execution budgets, audit/event and outbox; 202 only after known commit; exact replay has no new reservation/dispatch/capacity decision; ambiguous commit reconciles same key only.

Pending lasts through queued/blocked/reconciling/awaiting-approval and Temporal acknowledgement until the controlled durable execution-start transition or known terminal pre-start failure; authoritative PostgreSQL age >= cap refuses a nonempty pending set without deleting accepted work. Issue #16 later proves actual-worker-start integration.

Clients persist a secret-free key/intent before first client-to-API send, use at most three such sends in 30 seconds with deterministic 250ms/1s backoff, and never auto-rebase revisions or resubmit expired receipts. A server Retry-After may delay only within the remaining client deadline; provider/run-owned Retry-After and durable retry scheduling remain independent.
Retain safe response at least seven days; unresolved guards never age out; compact resolved responses to immutable namespace-lifetime refusal guards.
